summary.question: Performance monitoring shows degraded signal quality on service svc262 (10GE between S10 and S15) from about t=660 s. What is the cause?

llm.report: The system concludes that the cause is the combined fault AMP_GAIN_DROP@el:oms.S13-S20.amp1()+DGD_RISE@el:oms.S10-S19.span0(), with 0.994 probability. The first coherent diagnostic did not complete; a later run measured 27.17 dB estimated OSNR, 0.003399003557056801 pre-FEC BER, 9403 ps/nm chromatic dispersion, 38.2 ps DGD, and 2.54 dB margin. Portable OTDR found no events on oms.S13-S20.span0. Per-channel input power on oms.S13-S20 was 1.08 dBm. Swapping oms.S13-S20.amp1 cleared the symptoms.
